plugin.name: zeroclaw
plugin.description: Zeroclaw schema/RPC-native model router for Antigravity UI, CLI providers, and structured JSON output

configurable_options.description: Configurable options schema: registration, user container options, identity chain, memory namespaces, and privacy rules.

projection.description: Shared LLM projection fields (flattened to the top level).

message.description: Compatibility form for callers sending a single user turn.

messages.description: Full ordered conversation. When non-empty this takes precedence over `message`.

model.description: Model id or route hint. Empty uses `selected_model`.

provider.description: Provider id, route, or alias. Empty uses `selected_provider`.

finish_reason.description: Provider finish reason, or an empty string when none was supplied.

proto_type.description: Proto type, including optional/repeated marker when applicable.

required.description: True when this option is required by the source contract.

sensitive.description: True when the field contains sensitive material.

fields.description: Message fields keyed by proto field name.

registration_service.description: Magic-link and WireGuard registration RPC schema.

mac_address_key.description: Hardware-bound seed accepted by the user container flow.

pre_shared_key.description: Optional shared key accepted by the user container flow.

provider.description: Optional provider id, route, or alias used to filter the model catalog.

model_routes.description: Schema-declared model routes, optionally filtered by provider.

dbus_object.description: D-Bus object path served by this plugin.

incus_container.description: Incus / WireGuard container target for xray routing. Kept as a published-schema field for backward compatibility, but zeroclaw's LLM transport now runs on the host (xray through its runit-managed service and the gRPC-bridge via `op-grpc-bridge-zeroclaw`); there is no per-service incus container. Defaults to the `"host"` sentinel.

rest_aliases.description: REST aliases exposed by the bridge.

identity_link_key.description: Identity key used to bind this namespace to the container/user identity.

email_storage_rule.description: Whether email may be written to CozoDB.

sensitive_fields.description: Sensitive fields that must not be rendered casually.

messages.description: Message schemas used by those RPCs.

rpcs.description: RPC methods exposed by the registration service.

model_id.description: Model identifier declared in the model route catalog.

provider_id.description: Provider identifier declared in the provider catalog.

cognitive_mcp_endpoint.description: Cognitive MCP endpoint used by the user container memory flow.

feature_flags.description: Feature flags declared for the user container flow.

source_script.description: Source script that currently materializes the user container flow.

content.description: Text content carried by this conversation turn.

role.description: OpenAI-compatible message role such as `system`, `user`, or `assistant`.

message.description: Compatibility form for callers sending a single user turn.

messages.description: Full ordered conversation. When non-empty this takes precedence over `message`.

model.description: Model id or route hint. Empty uses `selected_model`.

provider.description: Provider id, route, or alias. Empty uses `selected_provider`.

finish_reason.description: Provider finish reason, or an empty string when none was supplied.

provider.description: Optional provider id, route, or alias used to filter the model catalog.

model_routes.description: Schema-declared model routes, optionally filtered by provider.

model_id.description: Model identifier declared in the model route catalog.

provider_id.description: Provider identifier declared in the provider catalog.
